review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Duties Include : Working directly with Director of Information Technology in planning, design, and support of ACSA Information Systems, verifying systems performance and operations, managing and maintaining employee information; Maintaining e-mail, active directory and backup for servers, Microsoft 365 and other cloud applications, maintaining and upgrading servers and phone systems as needed; Serving as project manager or providing direct support as an active partner for technology-related proj
eligibility_evidence: Hiring Range $77,622 - $93,146 Position Open Until Filled Come join a workforce dedicated to providing safe and reliable water to the citizens of Albemarle.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Minimum Qualifications : Bachelor's degree and 5-7 years' experience in related field; Thorough knowledge in hardware and software systems and programs, network design and administration, system troubleshooting, cyber and physical security, and disaster recovery; Abilities in systems administration and system design; intermediate to advanced knowledge of TCP/IP networking; knowledge and familiarity with Microsoft platforms, including but not limited to Windows desktop OS, Windows Server OS, Windows SQL server and Microsoft 365; Ability to install, configure, and maintain computers, servers and associated applications and peripherals; Familiarity with mobile device technologies; Strong oral and written communication skills.
